description: Creates a snapshot of a DB instance.

DBSnapshotArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the DB snapshot.

DBSnapshotIdentifier.description: The identifier for the DB snapshot. Must contain from 1 to 255 letters, numbers, or hyphens. First character must be a letter. Can't end with a hyphen or contain two consecutive hyphens.

DBInstanceIdentifier.description: The identifier of the DB instance that you want to create the snapshot of.

Tags.description: The tags to be assigned to the DB snapshot.

Engine.description: The name of the database engine.

EngineVersion.description: The version of the database engine.

AllocatedStorage.description: The allocated storage size in gibibytes (GiB).

Status.description: The status of this DB snapshot.

Port.description: The port that the database engine was listening on at the time of the snapshot.

AvailabilityZone.description: The name of the Availability Zone the DB instance was located in at the time of the DB snapshot.

VpcId.description: The VPC ID associated with the DB snapshot.

InstanceCreateTime.description: The time when the DB instance was created, in UTC.

MasterUsername.description: The master username for the DB snapshot.

SnapshotType.description: The type of the DB snapshot.

Iops.description: The Provisioned IOPS value of the DB instance at the time of the snapshot.

OptionGroupName.description: The option group name for the DB snapshot.

SnapshotCreateTime.description: The time when the snapshot was taken, in UTC.

Encrypted.description: Indicates whether the DB snapshot is encrypted.

KmsKeyId.description: If Encrypted is true, the AWS KMS key identifier for the encrypted DB snapshot.

StorageType.description: The storage type associated with the DB snapshot.

LicenseModel.description: License model information for the restored DB instance.

IAMDatabaseAuthenticationEnabled.description: Indicates whether mapping of AWS IAM accounts to database accounts is enabled.

DbiResourceId.description: The identifier for the source DB instance, which is unique to an AWS Region.

OriginalSnapshotCreateTime.description: The time of the CreateDBSnapshot operation in UTC. Doesn't change when the snapshot is copied.

StorageThroughput.description: The storage throughput for the DB snapshot.

Key.description: The key name of the tag.
